entities.name: Orzhova
entities.description: The lavish cathedral guildhall of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica, former seat of the Obzedat.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Ravnican guild whose guildhall is Orzhova.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The council of ghosts of the Orzhov, also called the Ghost Council.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: Goblin who with Lazav stole something from the quarters of the Obzedat.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Known then as Taz; stole something from the Obzedat with Krenko.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who fought toward Orzhova during the War of the Spark and later rested in her chambers there.

entities.name: Teyo
entities.description: Fought toward Orzhova during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: Fought toward Orzhova during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild whose officers investigated the theft.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle for Ravnica against Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: In 10,075 ZC Krenko and Lazav steal something from the quarters of the Obzedat and escape.
events.quote: stole something from the quarters of the Obzedat

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, Kaya, Teyo and Araithia Shokta fight toward Orzhova to gain the Orzhov guild's help.
events.quote: Orzhova became a goal for Kaya

events.summary: After the war the three return to Orzhova and rest in Kaya's chambers.
events.quote: going to Kaya's chambers to rest and recuperate

relations.quote: the guildhall of the Orzhov Syndicate on Ravnica
